besluite.fout: Bare 'het aangesluit' leaves 'joined what?' hanging; Afrikaans 'aansluit' naturally takes 'by' and an object.
besluite.rede: Adding 'by die VOC' completes the verb without adding a fact (the VOC is already named) and leaves the protected 'meestal arm' intact.
Lateral word-order move; 'seemanne aan diens op die dek' already reads naturally and the proposal is merely different.
'ná 'n tyd' is ordinary Afrikaans, not a calque, and 'ná 'n ruk' can suggest a shorter while, so the swap is lateral at best and risks shifting the time sense.
